actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.
actions.name: capture

facts.text: The experiment_camera_recorder package provides a transparent, static Gazebo RGB camera named experiment_camera and publishes sensor_msgs/Image messages on /experiment_camera/image_raw.

The camera description declares a Gazebo sensor of type camera with always_on true, an update rate from the update_rate argument, image width and height from the width and height arguments, and format R8G8B8.
The camera description loads libgazebo_ros_camera.so with cameraName experiment_camera, robotNamespace /, imageTopicName image_raw and cameraInfoTopicName camera_info.
camera.launch declares the launch arguments width, height and update_rate with the defaults 1280, 720 and 10.0.
camera.launch sets the experiment_camera_description parameter by running xacro on experiment_camera.urdf.xacro with width, height and update_rate taken from its launch arguments.
camera.launch starts frame_recorder.py only when its record argument is true and passes it the image_topic parameter /experiment_camera/image_raw.
The sensor and its camera plugin both set their always-on flags true (`always_on` and `alwaysOn`).

determinism.notes: Event-driven stand-in with fixed placeholder pixels; it does not advance a Gazebo world clock, render a scene or replay captured traffic.

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free scripted transport: it answers the declared image subscription and runs no Gazebo rendering, physics, sensor noise, lighting or camera pose
the fake returns a 4x3 RGB8 placeholder frame; the pinned launch defaults are 1280x720, and a live deployment may override width and height
the fake packet is one fixed sample with placeholder header stamps; it does not establish producer freshness, frame rate, exposure or a real acquisition timestamp
the fake does not model camera_info, calibration, the configured pose or the sensor clip range
the operator's ROS graph, rosbridge endpoint, Gazebo world and camera namespace are not contained by this package; no live ROS or camera run was performed

safe_state.description: No actuation: a capture is a passive read of the simulated camera and this package declares no motion command or stop endpoint.
